ألتزم (form VIII)
# أَلْتَزِمُ (ʔaltazimu) /ʔal.ta.zi.mu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِلْتَزَمَ (iltazama)
# أُلْتَزَمُ (ʔultazamu) /ʔul.ta.za.mu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِلْتَزَمَ (iltazama)
# أَلْتَزِمَ (ʔaltazima) /ʔal.ta.zi.ma/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِلْتَزَمَ (iltazama)
# أُلْتَزَمَ (ʔultazama) /ʔul.ta.za
